data.title: 105 Residences
data.about:
105 Residences by Kamdar at JVC offers an exclusive living experience with luxurious studio 1 and 2-bedroom apartments. Located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, this premium development combines modern design with exceptional amenities. Each residence is meticulously crafted to offer spacious layouts, high-end finishes, and breathtaking views.

The floor plan of 105 Residences at JVC is designed for ultimate comfort and convenience, with stylish interiors that suit both singles and families. Enjoy an array of top-tier amenities, including a swimming pool, multi-purpose court, kids' play area, and a fully-equipped gym. The master plan of 105 Residences integrates serene green spaces, providing a tranquil atmosphere.

The payment plan of 105 Residences is flexible, ensuring ease of investment. With its prime location and luxurious offerings, 105 Residences at JVC is the perfect choice for those seeking sophistication and comfort. Discover more about the floor plans and amenities today!

characteristics_module.title: Exquisite Design - Redefining Urban Sophistication
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Situated in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), offering easy access to key areas across Dubai.
  • Family-Friendly Community: JVC is a dynamic, family-oriented area, with a serene and comfortable atmosphere ideal for all family types.
  • Modern Design: 105 Residences by Kamdar offers luxurious, contemporary studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments with high-end finishes.
  • Exclusive Amenities: Residents enjoy a variety of top-tier amenities, including a swimming pool, rooftop cinema, fitness studio, and kids’ play areas.
  • Easy Connectivity: 105 Residences offers convenient access to major highways and attractions like Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Marina, and Downtown Dubai.
  • Green & Peaceful Environment: The master plan integrates lush green spaces, creating a peaceful atmosphere for residents.
  • Stunning Views: Apartments feature breathtaking views of Dubai’s skyline and surrounding greenery.

location_tile.title: Stategically Located at a Prime Location in JVC
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
105 Residences by Kamdar at JVC is ideally located in the heart of Dubai's Jumeirah Village Circle. This family-friendly community offers easy access to all major areas of Dubai. JVC is a dynamic development featuring stylish apartments, townhouses, and villas, complemented by world-class amenities. The 105 Residences location provides a serene setting, with retail communities just a short walk away. Discover the perfect blend of convenience and luxury living with the exceptional amenities and floor plans of 105 Residences at JVC.

  • 10 Minutes to Mall Of The Emirates
  • 15 Minutes Dubai Marina Mall
  • 25 Minutes Al Maktoum Airport
  • 20 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 30 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
